scope.deviation: Lead pitch and waveform are deliberately transformed during the first six body calls of three existing long octave statements; these are native instrument offsets, not additional score notes.

nativeAttack.tableEnding: Finite waveform/pitch table ends on base-pitch gated pulse; no pitch loop, vibrato, noise, sync or ring dependency.
